comment: No family is given for the signal input or the eight outputs: the module copies one voltage without looking at it, so what they carry is whatever is patched in. The outputs are numbered left to right and then down the panel, which is also the order the switch visits them (VCS.cpp:118-124). While the signal input is empty the module writes nothing to the selected output, so it holds the last voltage it was given rather than falling to 0V; the outputs it has moved away from are explicitly zeroed (line 67).
